snippet.title: 2004 - Vesmírná Becherovka (Space Becherovka) - Walkthrough - 1 - {ENG}
snippet.description:
http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL991BAC86312E0149

A walkthrough on another Becher adventure game, called 2004 - Space Becherovka (Vesmírná Becherovka - a parody of Space Oddysei), which does parodise many scifi works, like Star Wars, Startrek, Futurama (a parody of a parody? :-) ), Hitchhikers guide to the Galaxy, Star Gate etcetera with a humour only drunks of Becherovka could muster :-))))
